user.title: HomeKit Alchemy
user.description: Create a HomeKit Alchemy bridge for Apple Home.

abort.already_configured: HomeKit Alchemy bridge is already configured.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reload the HomeKit Alchemy YAML configuration without restarting Home Assistant.

reset_accessory.name: Reset accessory
reset_accessory.description: Make Apple Home forget the accessory and add it again, so it re-reads its structure. Its room and scenes in Apple Home have to be set again.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Main entities of the accessories to reset.

unpair.name: Unpair
unpair.description: Forget every paired iPhone/iPad of the HomeKit Alchemy bridge and its standalone accessories, so they can be added to Apple Home again.
